disabled.description: The bundled charts k3s is told not to install. Replaces the package's own list rather than adding to it. The components k3s 1.36 packages are offered as suggestions, not as the whole vocabulary: a chart the engine bundles without advertising it under --disable is accepted too, and cargoship warns when it configures a node with a name this build does not package.

usernames.description: Users whose pods skip pod security admission entirely. Replaces the package's list rather than adding to it.

runtimeClasses.description: Runtime classes whose pods skip pod security admission entirely. Replaces the package's list rather than adding to it.

namespaces.description: Namespaces whose pods skip pod security admission entirely. Replaces the package's list rather than adding to it, so name kube-system and zarf as well or the cluster's own components are enforced against.
